0022600189.text: Denver (4-3, 4th in the Northwest and 9th in the West, with a 2-1 road record) is the designated road team against Indiana (3-6, 3rd in the Central and 11th in the East, 0-4 at home) in this regular-season NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site, Denver's eighth game of the season. Denver is without DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Nuggets won the season series 2-0, including a 135-120 win in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
